A '''meiloorun''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] that had a rind and would split when overripe.<ref name="Wedge's Gamble" /> In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> members of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|fought]] a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the fight, [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax Terrik]]&mdash;one of the Rogues&mdash;shot a [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]], causing him to fall off his [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] and split his [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] in a way similar to an overripe meiloorun.<ref name="Wedge's Gamble" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
A meiloorun was mentioned in the [[1996]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]'' written by [[Michael A. Stackpole]] as the second installment in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''X-Wing'']] series.<ref name="Wedge's Gamble" />
